territorial_scope.description: Enacted by the Legislature of the State of Utah and applies to Utah.

evidence.quote: Be it enacted by the Legislature of the state of Utah:

summary.short: Sets a July 1, 2027 repeal date for the Artificial Intelligence Policy Act (Title 13, Chapter 72) in the repeal-date list of Section 63I-2-213, and lists repeal dates for other Title 13 provisions. Applies to Utah; effective May 7, 2025, except as Section 2(2) provides.
summary.long: S.B. 332 amends Section 63I-2-213, the Title 13 repeal-date list, and sets the bill's effective date. Subsection (5) of the amended list provides that Title 13, Chapter 72, Artificial Intelligence Policy Act, is repealed July 1, 2027. The other subsections set repeal dates for Section 13-1-16 (Latino Community Support Restricted Account) on July 1, 2024; Sections 13-14-103 and 13-35-103 (motor vehicle and powersport vehicle franchise advisory boards) on October 1, 2024; and Title 13, Chapter 47 (Private Employer Verification Act) on the program start date defined in Section 63G-12-102. The bill text does not mark which entries are new, and it does not set out the Artificial Intelligence Policy Act's substantive duties. Under Section 2, the bill takes effect May 7, 2025, except as provided in subsection (2). Subsection (2) applies if approved by two-thirds of all members elected to each house, and then takes effect on governor approval, on the day after the constitutional time limit without signature, or on the date of a veto override.

relations.note: Section 1 amends Utah Code § 63I-2-213, the repeal-date schedule for Title 13. The document shows the amended text only, which includes subsection (5) on Title 13, Chapter 72, Artificial Intelligence Policy Act.
Subsection (4) sets the repeal of Title 13, Chapter 47 by reference to the program start date as defined in Section 63G-12-102. That definition is not in this document.

evidence.quote: is repealed on the program start date, as defined in Section 63G-12-102.

relations.note: Section 2(2)(b) sets the effective date, without governor's signature, by reference to the constitutional time limit in Article VII, Section 8.

evidence.quote: the day following the constitutional time limit of Utah Constitution, Article VII, Section 8

notes: The document contains Section 1 (amending § 63I-2-213, repeal dates for Title 13) and Section 2 (effective date). It does not reproduce the text of Title 13, Chapter 72 (Artificial Intelligence Policy Act); the only AI-specific element is its repeal date of July 1, 2027 in subsection (5). Amendment markup (underlining or brackets) is not preserved, so which subsections are new cannot be verified from the document. No internal inconsistencies were found. Relations are recorded above; the section_status entry below is formal only.

thresholds.note: This bill only amends repeal dates in Utah Code 63I-2-213 and sets an effective date. Its numbers are calendar dates (for example, repeal of Title 13, Chapter 72, Artificial Intelligence Policy Act on July 1, 2027), which are events rather than thresholds. It contains no numeric cutoff that changes the legal treatment of any person, entity or product.
